description: This file defines a custom exception class 'ChargeCannotBeAppliedToException' which extends 'AbstractPlatformDomainRuleException'. It is used within the 'org.apache.fineract.portfolio.charge.exception' package to signal errors related to applying charges to invalid entities.

classes.name: ChargeCannotBeAppliedToException
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating that a charge cannot be applied to a certain entity, used for domain rule violations.

methods.name: ChargeCannotBeAppliedToException
methods.description: Constructor that builds the exception with a specific error code and message.
